title: Sean Payton talks about the range of emotions during the final play in win vs. Chiefs

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean Payton talks about the range of emotions during the final play in win vs. Chiefs
sources.description: “I’m screaming at Vance one second and then I’m hugging Vance and shaking Andy’s hand." - Sean Payton during the final play of the game.
